abstract: A total of 145 consecutive primary testicular tumors were treated with radiation therapy at the University of Michigan Hospital from 1955 through 1974. In patients with seminoma, the 5-year survival rate was 98% for Stage I and 88% for Stage II regardless of whether retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was done. The 5-year survival rate for embryonal carcinoma was 63% for Stage I and 66% for Stage II. For teratocarcinoma it was 100% for Stage I and 54% for Stage II. Adjuvant chemotherapy appeared to be beneficial for patients with Stage II teratocarcinoma but made no difference in patients with embryonal carcinoma.
abstract_ja: 1955年から1974年にミシガン大学病院で放射線療法を受けた原発性精巣腫瘍145例を連続して検討した。セミノーマでは、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の有無にかかわらず、5年生存率は病期Iで98%、病期IIで88%であった。胎児性癌の5年生存率は病期Iで63%、病期IIで66%であった。奇形癌では、病期Iで100%、病期IIで54%であった。補助化学療法は病期II奇形癌の患者に有益と思われたが、胎児性癌には差がなかった。
